claims.statement: On the phase-a exact-U1 scalar court, the canonical IR round-trips (decode(encode(x))==x, canonical form verified), the scalar materializer is deterministic (identical canonical SHA-256 across repeated materializations), and partial-domain requests equal full-surface crops, on this host and commit.
claims.domain: vole.gfx.u1 exact profile, scalar backend, CPU, single commit; see receipt phase-a-*

claims.statement: 12 pinned conformance vectors (fills, layered/indexed sprites, palette animation, trajectories at 0/16.6/33.3ms and irregular times, move+fill, sparse-overwrite and XOR residual closure incl. Gray8 format-skip) reproduce their scalar-oracle SHA-256 exactly; adversarial fuzz (truncations, bit flips, random bytes, deep copy stacks) never panics and fails closed.
claims.domain: vole.gfx.u1 exact profile, scalar backend, CPU, this commit; see receipt phase-b-*

claims.statement: Blocked materializer (uniform-grid dependency index + per-block op culling + memoized copy/move prefix evaluation) is byte-for-byte identical to the scalar oracle across all swept block shapes at 1920x1080 (150 instances, fills, copies, sparse residual); a 1% domain region costs ~0.6% of full-surface work on this host and commit (work tracks requested samples, not full surface).
claims.domain: vole.gfx.u1 exact profile, scalar vs blocked CPU backends, this host+commit; see receipt phase-c-*

claims.statement: AVX2 simple path (exact opaque integer-translation row blits + opaque fills + residual closure) is byte-identical to the scalar oracle; on the 1920x1080 200-sprite court this host (Zen5, AVX2) measured median materialization ~131us vs ~213.8ms scalar oracle, ~13.6ms scalar blocked and ~2.9ms scalar-simple. The ablation rows decompose the speedup: ~73x algorithmic specialization of the eligible subset (scalar oracle -> scalar-simple, same engine as the SIMD paths) and ~22x SIMD gain (scalar-simple -> avx2); the large scalar->AVX2 ratio is NOT presented as SIMD alone.
claims.domain: vole.gfx.u1 exact profile, eligible subset, this host+commit; see receipt cpu-backend-matrix (phase d)

claims.statement: AVX-512 simple path reproduces the same bytes; on this court it measured ~147us vs ~131us AVX2 — AVX-512 loses on this memory-bound workload (retained as negative evidence; no assumed 512>256 win; auto dispatch prefers AVX2 on the same evidence).
claims.domain: vole.gfx.u1 exact profile, eligible subset, this host+commit; see receipt cpu-backend-matrix (phase e)

claims.statement: Rayon band-parallel materialization is byte-identical to the oracle and deterministic across band heights and thread counts; on this court rayon-avx2 ~284us, rayon-avx512 ~263us, rayon-scalar ~2.3ms, rayon-auto ~316us (band height 64, block 16x16); auto dispatch recorded the avx2 path.
claims.domain: vole.gfx.u1 exact profile, this host+commit; see receipt cpu-backend-matrix (phase f)

claims.statement: Rust device code (extern ptx-kernel) compiles to launchable PTX (.visible .entry vgf_fill_u8/vgf_copy_u8, sm_89) via the pinned nightly nvptx64-nvidia-cuda target with no CUDA C++; the PTX loads through the CUDA driver and both kernels produce output byte-identical to the CPU reference on the RTX 4080 SUPER of this host.
claims.domain: vole.gfx.u1 byte kernels, nightly-2026-07-24, sm_89, this host+commit; see receipt phase-g-*

claims.statement: Ten bounded generator families (constant, gradient, palette-field, periodic, tiled, affine-reuse, deterministic-field, fractal, sdf, object-family) are normative U1 state with canonical versioned param wire encodings, semantic validation, bounded work-unit cost estimators, and exact deterministic evaluation; on the 1920x1080 ten-family court every request shape evaluated exactly its requested samples (full 2,073,600 / region-1pct 20,736 / tile 4,096 / scanline 1,920 / band 61,440 / irregular 5), so partial observations never re-bake whole objects (direct seeded evaluation), and scalar/blocked/rayon outputs are byte-identical; the pure-constant subset dispatches to the avx2 fill path (~113us) byte-identically, while other families run the exact scalar/blocked path in this phase. Pinned conformance hashes cover the mixed scene in RGBA and Gray8 at two observation times.
claims.domain: vole.gfx.u1 exact profile, CPU, this host+commit; see receipt phase-h-*

claims.statement: The scalar inverse compiler unbakes raster assets into Pareto frontiers of exact explanations (detectors: constant, 2-color periodic stripes/checker, palette-band cycles, tiled wrap periods, gradient ramps, bilinear corner fit, literal fallback). On the seven-class phase-i court the byte-min profile recovers constant/checker/palette-bands/tiled/bilinear at ~140-170 persistent bytes with zero residual (vs ~literal KBs), the hash-noise negative control falls back to literal, and every winner materializes its asset byte-for-byte (closure gate). Frontiers are deterministic: the four cost axes (persistent bytes, residual bytes, host-independent materialization-work model, search work) exclude measured wall-clock from dominance.
claims.domain: vole.gfx.u1 exact profile, scalar CPU, this host+commit; see receipt phase-i-*

claims.statement: Structural reuse detectors extract a dominant field color, label 4-connected foreground components, group byte-equal content classes, and emit composite explanations: sprite-on-field (524 B persistent, zero residual) and sprite-repeat with the crop stored once (570 B for 2 copies, 616 B for 3, vs ~12 KB literal on the phase-j court), with every winner reproducing its asset byte-for-byte; the noise negative control falls back to literal. Composite (multi-object) proposals extend the Phase I Pareto pipeline unchanged.
claims.domain: vole.gfx.u1 exact profile, scalar CPU, this host+commit; see receipt phase-j-*

claims.statement: Search work is now counted exactly where it occurs (inverse::work::SearchCounter; frozen pixels_read + code_compares + hash_ops + candidate_tests + crop_bytes_compared conversion): the tiled detector reports its per-period plane re-scans (129,316 units vs the previous flat 3,072 on the phase-j sprite-on-field court), structural proposals report flood-fill probes and byte-exact crop comparisons, gradient probes on noise report only the samples actually examined, and the literal fallback carries zero search cost; receipts record the per-candidate breakdown. Residual bytes are now the canonical delta encode(doc_with_residual) - persistent_bytes, so they include the residual binding's structural overhead (+39 B per binding on the phase-i/j courts) and persistent + residual equals the exact stored document size by construction. On the phase-i and phase-j courts the candidate sets, profile winners, and the byte counts of zero-residual winners are unchanged; only search-axis values and residual-carrying candidates' residual deltas shifted.
claims.domain: vole.gfx.u1 exact profile, scalar CPU inverse compiler, this host+commit; see receipt phase-i-* phase-j-*
